hero.subtitle: Editorial journeys into the neighborhoods, rituals, and stories that reveal the city beneath the surface. Thoughtfully designed to explore at your own pace.

about.title: Immerse Yourself in Mexican Culture
about.description: We curate unique experiences that reveal the authentic heart of Mexico, from ancient ruins to hidden coastal gems. Each journey is designed with luxury, discretion, and genuine connection at its core.

aboutPage.taglineEs: The embrace of the city we love.
aboutPage.taglineEn: Mexico City, the way we hug it.
aboutPage.whoLead: Calpulli CDMX was born from two stories crossing in Mexico City: one of us is from Oaxaca and lives here today; the other was born in CDMX but hasn't lived here for years. Between us we know, almost by chance, the most different poles of this city — its markets, its rooftops, its corners that don't appear in any guide. One day we decided it was worth sharing.
aboutPage.founderOaxDesc: lives in CDMX, walks it every day
aboutPage.founderDefDesc: born here, now sees it from afar — and misses it
aboutPage.whyLead: “Chilango” has been used for years to belittle those who live in this city. We believe it's the opposite: being chilango means having learned to love a huge, noisy and contradictory city, and finding in it something that feels like home. Calpulli CDMX exists to show that version of Mexico City — the one of flavors, places, smells and surrealism that you only understand by walking it with a local.
aboutPage.forWhoLead: We design each route for solo travelers or small groups who want more than a list of photos.
aboutPage.cardFlavorsDesc: Eat where locals eat, not where tourists eat.
aboutPage.cardPlacesDesc: Neighborhoods with their own name and history, beyond the three avenues everyone knows.
aboutPage.cardSurrealDesc: That part of CDMX that feels made up, and you only get by seeing it up close.
aboutPage.contactCardDesc: Write us and we'll help you plan your next visit to the city — no tourist traps.
aboutPage.symbolDesc: We chose the jaguar — not as caricature, but as symbol. We took it to its simplest form: a gaze that appears between carved stone planes, the geometric stroke of those who carve wood for generations. It's a nod to that Mexican popular craft, and to the silent strength with which this city welcomes you when you already know it.
aboutPage.footerTitle: Ready to discover the CDMX you won't find in guides?
aboutPage.footerSub: Write us and we'll help you plan your next visit to the city — no tourist traps.
aboutPage.footTagline: The embrace of the city we love.

cardStack.oaxContent: Lives in CDMX, walks it every day. Knows the markets that open before dawn, the rooftops with the most honest mezcal, and the corners no digital map points to.
cardStack.defContent: Born here, now sees it from afar — and misses it. That distance gives a perspective locals sometimes lose: he knows the treasures a visitor would never find alone.
cardStack.amxContent: The crossing of two stories. Between the two we cover the most different poles of this city — and we decided it was worth sharing with anyone who wants to feel the real CDMX.
